name: Dishthwack
description: Chop and carry the same flow of qi straight into a second chop from the recovered blade.

name: Rooted Dishguard
description: End a cut in a braced guard in one motion so no opening is left between them.

name: Pirouetting Spineback
description: Slip a short pace aside between two cuts so the second arrives from a new angle.

name: Slicescorer
description: Draw one slice into another along the target with a continuous thread of qi on the belly.

name: Rooted Chopbelly
description: Turn a parry into a returning cut by letting the blade keep the motion of the deflection.

name: Bevelswat
description: Follow a high cut with a level sweep at the waist on the same turn of the hips.

name: Bold Tipbend
description: Hew three times on a single breath with qi renewed along the edge for each stroke.

name: Gripping Swathe
description: Rap the spine into the gap of a foe's chain of cuts and break the rhythm of its qi.

name: Curvespine Swat
description: Swing the sabre arm through a loose full arc that loosens the joints and ends in a cut.

name: Rooted Rearedge
description: Fold the elbow tight against the ribs and hold the blade upright to cover the flank.

name: Lurching Flatside
description: Snap the wrist at the end of a short swing to add a sharp bite to the edge.

name: Pirouetting Knucklebar
description: Roll the shoulder forward and step in under a swing to close on the foe.

name: Scrapethwack
description: Lunge with the tip of the sabre and drive qi through the point to pierce a guard.

name: Scrapebarrier
description: Hook the curve over the foe's weapon arm and pull it in against the body to pin it.

name: Bellyblade Hasp
description: Hang the blade point-down before the body so the spine and belly cover the front.

name: Brushslap
description: Release the hanging blade upward and forward into a cut from below the foe's guard.

name: Rooted Ringpommel
description: Drop the point and slide an incoming blade down the length of the hanging sabre.

name: Veering Whisk
description: Step back out of reach while keeping the blade hanging as a moving screen.

name: Flatside Hasp
description: Slant the hanging blade to catch a cut on the spine and let a little qi harden it.

name: Dire Swathe
description: Draw the hanging belly upward across the target in a long rising slice.

name: Chophasp
description: Turn aside a cut with the hanging blade and return a rising cut in the same motion.

name: Gripping Tipbend
description: Strike the foe's raised blade from beneath with qi in the spine and jar its hold apart.

name: Dishprop
description: Swing the hanging blade in tight loops before the body to make a moving curtain of steel and qi.

name: Rushing Dragcut
description: Chase a retreating foe with a long step and cut at the back of the step.

name: Brutal Brush
description: Slash after the foe's blade as it withdraws and keep the edge against it.

name: Dishglide
description: Hold a steady fast pace behind a retreating foe with the blade carried ready at the hip.

name: Savage Scrape
description: Hew low at the heel or calf of a foe turning to run.

name: Knucklebar Barrier
description: Parry a backward cut thrown by the fleeing foe while still closing the distance.

name: Scrapeflog
description: Burst forward with qi in the legs and slash across the target at the end of the run.

name: Prowling Chopbelly
description: Cut across a foe's line of flight with a swift qi-lit step and pin it against an obstacle.

name: Fierce Slice
description: Open with a cut that rolls off the wrist and begins the turning motion of the style.

name: Stubborn Rearedge
description: Roll the blade out and back across the body so the return stroke serves as a guard.

name: Bellyblade Flog
description: Tumble the blade over the wrist in a small loop and slash as it comes round.

name: Ducking Scrape
description: Roll the body aside on the line of the turning blade to leave a cut behind.

name: Bevelbuckle
description: Roll the spine against an attack so its force runs round the turning blade.

name: Stern Curvespine
description: Wheel the blade over the shoulder and chop with the weight of the full turn.

name: Sturdy Dishguard
description: Carry a missed wheel on round to a guard before the foe can counter.

name: Bevelflog
description: Wheel the blade twice through the target with qi renewed in each turn to tear a wide wound.

name: Resolute Spineback
description: Parry on the turn of the wheel and shake the foe's qi flow loose through the contact.

name: Swift Brush
description: Keep the sabre whirling in a ring of cuts that forces the foe back step by step.

name: Cruel Dragcut
description: Press edge against edge and lean through the contact to push the foe's blade aside.

name: Stalwart Spineback
description: Let the foe's edge slide along the flat of the blade and off the hilt guard.

name: Gritbrush
description: Step in while the blades are crossed so the foe cannot withdraw cleanly.

name: Emberbevel
description: Hew across the foe's blade to carry it down and cut on past it.

name: Shielding Knucklebar
description: Turn the edge outward as the blades touch and roll the foe's weapon off its line.

name: Chopbelly Slap
description: Shave along the foe's blade toward the hand with the edge keeping contact.

name: Sleet Whisk
description: Lock the crossed edges and wrench the foe's weapon out of line with a twist of the wrist.

name: Bellyblade Barrier
description: Beat the foe's edge with a hard qi-laden stroke that jars its technique apart.

name: Tipbend Barrier
description: Wrap the blade over the back of the head and shoulders to cover the upper body.

name: Slice Slap
description: Cut round from behind the neck in a wide arc that comes at the foe from the side.

name: Swatheslap
description: Wrap the blade over the shoulder and sweep it level through the foe's guard.

name: Curvespine Swerve
description: Turn the body inside the wrap and step through to the foe's flank.

name: Rugged Dishguard
description: Slash backward over the shoulder at a foe who closes from behind.

name: Raw Ringpommel
description: Wrap twice about the body in a shearing ring that guards and then cuts outward with qi.

name: Cramping Dragcut
description: Wrap the blade round the foe's weapon arm and pull until it is bound against the body.

name: Honed Scrape
description: Whirl the blade once in a circle above the head and cut from the top of the circle.

name: Chopprop
description: Keep the blade turning above the head to cover the upper body from falling cuts.

name: Brawn Flatside
description: Let the circle drop at once into a downward cut with the speed of the turn.

name: Gritchop
description: Step sideways under the turning blade so the foe's attack passes beside the body.

name: Poise Rearedge
description: Sweep half a circle with the blade to carry an incoming cut up and away.

name: Bold Ringpommel
description: Flick the wrist at the top of the circle to throw a quick cut at the foe's eyes.

name: Draught Brush
description: Bring the circle down with a heavy hew backed by a surge of qi through the edge.

name: Unmoving Bellyblade
description: Scatter an incoming cut with the turning blade and unsettle the qi behind it.

name: Moment Swathe
description: Drive the foe back with circles that climb from low to high and keep its blade pinned down.

name: Brassbevel
description: Hold the sabre edge-out along the forearm so the spine takes the first blow.

name: Brawnbevel
description: Slash backward from the reversed grip at a foe who has passed the shoulder.

name: Brass Scrape
description: Draw the hidden edge along the foe's arm as the forearm sweeps past it.

name: Sprigdish
description: Raise the blade along the forearm in reverse grip and meet a cut on the flat.

name: Ember Slice
description: Hew low from the reversed grip at the shin of a closing foe.

name: Grit Rearedge
description: Pivot on the lead foot behind the reversed blade and come out at the foe's side.

name: Brawn Dragcut
description: Flip the grip from reversed to forward and chop with the sudden change in reach.

name: Stamp Flatside
description: Hook the curve behind the foe's knee or elbow in reverse grip and pull the limb out of line.

name: Honeddish
description: Thrust the tip upward under the foe's raised arm with qi concentrated at the point.

name: Padded Ringpommel
description: Parry in reverse grip and switch to forward grip for a cut as the foe's blade falls away.

name: Emberdish
description: Chop without flourish from a settled stance with the full weight of a practiced arm.

name: Seasoned Tipbend
description: Take a blow on the worn middle of the blade where long use has settled the steel.

name: Brawnswathe
description: Advance one unhurried step at a time and keep the blade where it covers the most.

name: Rugged Whisk
description: Slice evenly through the target in a single unbroken draw with qi steady on the belly.

name: Whiskscreen
description: Break the foe's guard with a timed beat that unsettles its qi at the moment of contact.

name: Draught Dishguard
description: Bring the whole weight of the body through one hew backed by a full pulse of qi.
